tasks.label: Archive Duplicate Files
tasks.command: mkdir -p dev_backup && find . \( -path "./node_modules" -o -path "./.next" -o -path "./.git" -o -path "./dev_backup" \) -prune -o -type f \( -name "* copy.js" -o -name "* copy [0-9]*.js" \) -exec sh -c 'mkdir -p dev_backup/$(dirname "{}") && mv "{}" dev_backup/"{}"' \;

tasks.label: Restore Duplicate Files
tasks.command: cp -r dev_backup/* . 2>/dev/null && echo "Files restored." || echo "Backup empty."

tasks.label: Clear Backup
tasks.command: rm -rf dev_backup/* 2>/dev/null && echo "Backup cleared." || echo "Nothing to clear."
